# notes

The user's private note on a decision: text to remember, never sent to the
agent. One row per decision in `decisions_ext_notes` (an entity extension of
`decisions`, cascading with it); it is not part of what the decision says, so
neither its `updated_at` nor its history sees it. The UI is
`primitives/side-note`, contributed into the DecisionCard's slots: the toggle
beside the answer's editor (`AnswerAction`), the note above the answer box
(`AboveAnswer`).

## Plugin reference

- Description: A private note on each decision, never sent to the agent: a note icon on the right of the answer's editor opens it (a dot while it has text), and the auto-saved note shows above the answer box — on every surface a decision is answered in (the inbox, the conversation tray, the page block), and still shown once the decision is closed. The user's private note on a decision (decisions_ext_notes, one per decision): the decision-notes live rows and the PUT / DELETE routes that save it. Never sent to the agent.
- Web:
